metadata.name: HTTP Client
metadata.summary: Generate and validate HTTP call nodes for Greentic flows
metadata.description: Teaches the Designer LLM to generate YGTc HTTP nodes from natural language, curl commands, or card submit contexts. Wraps component-http runtime — does not make HTTP calls itself.

tools.name: generate_http_node
tools.description: Generate a YGTc HTTP node from natural language intent. Detects the HTTP method, path, base URL and auth type from the intent text and emits a node stanza wired to the component-http runtime, with a rationale explaining the choices.
tools.input_schema: {"type":"object","properties":{"intent":{"type":"string","description":"Natural-language description of the HTTP call, e.g. \"POST to CRM /api/leads with JSON body, bearer auth\". The method is taken from a POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE/GET keyword (default GET), the path from the first /-prefixed token, the base URL from the first http(s):// token, and the auth type from the words \"bearer\", \"api key\"/\"api-key\" or \"basic auth\" (default none)."},"context":{"type":"object","description":"Optional generation hints.","properties":{"base_url_hint":{"type":"string","description":"Base URL to use instead of one detected in the intent."},"secret_names":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string"},"description":"Secret names available to the flow. When auth is required the first name containing HTTP, TOKEN or API is referenced as \"secret:<NAME>\"; if the list is empty the node falls back to \"secret:HTTP_TOKEN\"."}},"additionalProperties":true}},"required":["intent"]}

tools.name: validate_http_config
tools.description: Validate a generated YGTc HTTP node and return diagnostics. Checks that config.base_url is present and uses a supported scheme, that config.auth_type is known and carries an auth_token (warning when the token is not a "secret:<NAME>" reference), and that config.timeout_ms is greater than zero and not above the recommended 60000 ms.
tools.input_schema: {"type":"object","properties":{"node":{"type":"object","description":"The HTTP node to validate. Only its \"config\" block is inspected.","properties":{"config":{"type":"object","properties":{"base_url":{"type":"string","description":"Required. Must be a valid URL with a supported scheme."},"auth_type":{"type":"string","enum":["none","bearer","api_key","basic"],"description":"Defaults to \"none\" when absent."},"auth_token":{"type":"string","description":"Required unless auth_type is \"none\". Should be a \"secret:<NAME>\" reference; a raw token is reported as a warning."},"timeout_ms":{"type":"integer","description":"Must be greater than 0; above 60000 is reported as a warning."}},"additionalProperties":true}},"additionalProperties":true}},"required":["node"]}

tools.name: curl_to_node
tools.description: Convert a curl command into a YGTc HTTP node. Splits the URL into base_url and path, maps the method, body and remaining headers onto the node, rewrites an Authorization: Bearer/Basic header into a "secret:<NAME>" reference, and reports curl flags it could not map as diagnostics.
tools.input_schema: {"type":"object","properties":{"curl_cmd":{"type":"string","description":"The full curl command to import, e.g. \"curl -X POST https://api.example.com/users -H 'Authorization: Bearer xxx' -d '{\\\"name\\\":\\\"alice\\\"}'\". It must contain a URL."},"node_id":{"type":"string","description":"Node id for the generated node. Defaults to \"http_call\"."}},"required":["curl_cmd"]}

tools.name: suggest_auth
tools.description: Recommend auth configuration from a natural-language API description. Matches the description against a table of known APIs (GitHub, OpenAI/Anthropic/Cohere, Airtable, Slack/Discord) and returns auth_type, a "secret:<NAME>" token reference, any default headers, a rationale and a confidence level; unknown APIs come back as auth_type "unknown" with low confidence.
tools.input_schema: {"type":"object","properties":{"api_description":{"type":"string","description":"Description of the API to authenticate against, e.g. \"GitHub REST API v3\". Matched case-insensitively against the known-API keyword list."}},"required":["api_description"]}

tools.name: generate_from_card_submit
tools.description: Generate an HTTP node that maps Adaptive Card submit fields to an API body. Collects every Input.* id in the card, builds a JSON body_template of "${submit.<id>}" placeholders, and returns a card_to_body mapping plus the fields it deliberately left unmapped.
tools.input_schema: {"type":"object","properties":{"card_schema":{"type":"object","description":"The Adaptive Card JSON. Walked recursively for elements whose \"type\" starts with \"Input.\"; each such element's \"id\" becomes a body field.","additionalProperties":true},"api_intent":{"type":"string","description":"Natural-language description of the API call, e.g. \"POST to /api/tickets with form fields as JSON\". The method comes from a post/put/patch keyword (default POST) and the path from the first /-prefixed token (default \"/\")."},"node_id":{"type":"string","description":"Node id for the generated node. Defaults to \"http_call\"."}},"required":["card_schema","api_intent"]}
